---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page of the TurboTrack Motors used-car showroom website.
---
1. Brand name is "TurboTrack Motors"; tagline is "Your first car, without the fuss."
2. Colours: background #0F1115, cards #1C1F26, primary red #E63946, accent yellow #FFB703, text #F1F1F1. No other colours.
3. Headings use the Google font Rajdhani (bold); body text uses Inter.
4. Tone: confident, friendly, short sentences. Speak to first-time buyers.
5. Prices are written as "Rs 32,50,000" using Pakistani comma style (never PKR, never lakh written in words).
6. Mileage is written as "45,000 km" and model years as "2019".
7. Every page has a header with the brand name and links (Cars, Calculator, Book a Test Drive), and a footer saying "Open 10am to 8pm, Mon to Sat, Main Boulevard Gulberg, Lahore".
8. Every car card shows an emoji, the make and model, year, mileage, transmission (Auto/Manual) and price.
9. Forms must check that phone numbers have exactly 11 digits and start with 03.
10. Pages must look good on a phone first.
11. Keep each page in a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inside it.
12. Never use stock photos or real brand logos; use emoji (🚗🚙🏎️) or simple shapes instead.
